summary: The stale-access check stays current on large tenants, and PIM Activator points users to support.

fixes.title: Stale-access check stays current on large tenants
fixes.text: On large, busy tenants, the group activity behind the stale-access check now catches up run by run instead of staying old.

fixes.title: PIM Activator carries the PIM Manager name
fixes.text: PIM Activator now shows it is part of PIM Manager, with a Support link, and Report bug opens the support portal. Installed browsers update in place.
